data.question: What public acquisition lineage and named personnel can be established around FBI-TSC-AIE without inventing applicants?
data.method: Exact notice-identifier search, distinctive-phrase search, procurement-contact pivoting, official FBI personnel review and bounded respondent search.
findings: FBI-TSC-AIE names Brandon James as contracting officer and requires capability packages to be emailed directly to him.

The same public contracting contact appears on a cluster of FBI market-research notices involving intelligence production modernization, big-data extraction, communications analysis, supply-chain illumination, decentralized criminal-justice information sharing and image capture/document processing.
The cluster supports acquisition-lineage and workload mapping, not a finding that the requirements share vendors, evaluators, systems or funding.
Harriett Williams is publicly named on the Supply Chain Illumination RFI but is not publicly tied to FBI-TSC-AIE.
Michael Glasheen was publicly identified as TSC director in March 2025 and as FBI Operations Director by December 2025; the March 2026 TSC director remains unresolved.
Nicholas Dimos was named head of FBI contracting activity in 2022; his 2026 role is not established by the reviewed sources.
No authenticated respondent list, capability package, briefing roster, evaluation matrix, follow-on solicitation, award or selected vendor was located.
conclusions: Do not label any company a respondent or applicant yet.
Treat the Brandon James notice cluster as a procurement-lineage lead.
Acquire FBI response logs, market-research records and briefing rosters before enumerating company personnel as bid participants.
limitations: RFI responses were submitted by email and may be withheld as procurement-sensitive or proprietary.
Public procurement mirrors can omit attachments, revisions or metadata.
Contact overlap alone does not prove programmatic linkage.
unresolved: Every FBI-TSC-AIE respondent and named response personnel.
Current TSC director and Information Technology Unit requirement owner as of March 2026.
Acquisition planner, technical evaluators, AI Ethics Council reviewers and briefing attendees.
Any follow-on solicitation, award, task order, cancellation or decision not to proceed.

title: FBI-TSC-AIE respondent, evaluation and briefing records — depth 3
summary: Records-production target to identify every respondent and response-linked person without inferring participation from capability similarity.

data.research_question: Which entities responded to FBI-TSC-AIE, who represented them, and which government personnel evaluated or briefed them?
hypotheses: The response-receipt log and market-research report identify respondents even if technical submissions are withheld.
Briefing invitations and calendars identify a smaller set of vendors and named personnel.
A follow-on acquisition may use a different notice identifier while reusing distinctive requirement language.
objectives: Obtain response-receipt logs and respondent business identifiers.
Obtain market-research reports, capability matrices and evaluation records.
Obtain briefing invitations, schedules, attendee lists and presentation metadata.
Search for follow-on solicitations, awards, task orders, cancellations and acquisition decisions.
Enumerate company and government personnel only when direct response or evaluation evidence exists.
out_of_scope: proprietary technical content not lawfully released
selection_reason: Respondent identities are not published on the RFI page.
Direct records are required before applicant personnel can be enumerated.

data.research_question: What is the next public-source layer around FBI-TSC-AIE after the respondent list could not be located?
data.method: Procurement-contact pivoting, exact notice search, official personnel verification and status separation.
classification_rules: A shared contracting officer is procurement lineage, not proof of shared vendors or systems.
An RFI response is not an offer or award.
Capability similarity is not respondent evidence.
Historical personnel appointments are not assumed current.

findings.finding: Brandon James is the direct public contracting contact for FBI-TSC-AIE.
A broader FBI data/search/analytics RFI portfolio is linked by the same contracting contact.
A public FBI-TSC-AIE respondent list was located.
Any company can currently be labeled a confirmed FBI-TSC-AIE respondent.

data.next_action: Acquire response, evaluation and briefing metadata; then enumerate each confirmed respondent's bid-linked personnel.
